user.title: Memobird printer
user.description: Local network address of the printer. Give it a fixed IP in your router.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the printer at this address.

print.name: Print
print.description: Print text on the Memobird printer.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to print. Characters outside GBK (e.g. emoji) print as '?'.

big.name: Large font
big.description: Print the message in the large font.

timestamp.name: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Print the current date and time under the title.

format.name: Format
format.description: `plain`, `markdown` (`**bold**`, `*italic*`, `++underline++`, `~~strike~~`, `` `code` ``, `# heading`, `- list`) or `html` (tags b, i, u, s, code, big, small, h1-h3, center, ul/ol/li, hr, br). Defaults to the integration options.

print_image.name: Print image
print_image.description: Print an image from a file, a URL or a camera snapshot. It is scaled to the paper width (384 dots) and converted to black and white.

file.name: File
file.description: Local path, e.g. /config/www/photo.jpg. Must be in allowlist_external_dirs.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Camera entity to take a snapshot from.

title.name: Title
title.description: Large bold heading above the image.

dither.name: Dithering
dither.description: Simulate grey shades with dots (good for photos). Turn off for logos, QR codes and line art.

timestamp.name: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Print the current date and time under the title.

format.name: Format
format.description: Caption format: `plain`, `markdown` (`**bold**`, `*italic*`, `++underline++`, `~~strike~~`, `` `code` ``, `# heading`, `- list`) or `html` (tags b, i, u, s, code, big, small, h1-h3, center, ul/ol/li, hr, br). Defaults to the integration options.

init.title: Memobird options
init.description: Markdown and HTML are rendered as an image with bundled fonts, so single words can be bold, italic, underlined or struck through. Plain text uses the printer's built-in font.

data_description.default_format: Used by notify.send_message and when an action doesn't set format.
